content:
As the iPhone Duo release date approaches, Apple has begun accepting submissions of apps and games built with Xcode 27.1 and optimized for iPhone Duo. Details below.

App Store Connect will require iPhone Duo screenshots for submissions starting April 2027

Over the past few weeks, Apple has released Xcode 27.1 beta versions supporting the building and testing of iPhone Duo apps and games. Apple today released Xcode 27.1 Release Candidate 1, which developers can download here.

Earlier tonight, Apple published an article on its Developer News Hub announcing that developers can now submit apps and games optimized for iPhone Duo through App Store Connect:

When you build or recompile with Xcode 27.1, your App Store product page will display a badge letting users know that your app has been optimized for iPhone Duo.

Importantly, Apple also noted that starting April 2027, any app or game submitted to App Store Connect must include iPhone Duo screenshots.

In the same news article, Apple emphasized that recompiling existing apps with Xcode 27.1 can add development support for iPhone Duo, and developers can also use the Device Hub to preview how their apps work in various postures and orientations on the new device.

Apple also listed a number of resources to help developers prepare apps and App Store product pages for iPhone Duo, including:

  • Get design guidelines and templates
  • Manage your App Store assets
  • View app preview specifications
  • View screenshot specifications

Apple will hold several iPhone Duo in-person workshops over the coming days. For details and registration, please visit here.

iPhone Duo will be available for pre-order starting Friday, October 16, with deliveries and in-store availability beginning October 23.

Apple previously announced that customers can prepare for iPhone Duo pre-orders starting October 12. Details can be read here.
